notes: Reworks Split Full Cover around the drag-and-drop workflow. Multiple dropped wraps now appear as vertically stacked cover editors on one long scrolling page instead of a Previous/Next queue. Removes the leftover Add Multiple Full Wraps button, corrects save/storage wording so the full wrap is clearly only a temporary source and the saved items are Back Cover, Spine, and Front Cover, adds 50–400% zoom with +/-, Fit, Ctrl+mouse-wheel, and scroll/pan, and adds a mode toggle between numeric/button guide adjustment and direct drag-the-split-lines editing. The same zoom and drag-lines controls are also available for a single dropped wrap. Windows validation passed for scrolling multi-cover editors, zoom limits, drag-line mode, regular single-cover zoom, and saving all expected split pieces.
